items.selection_reason: The file page identifies the graph as 言 in Shuowen seal-script style, which illustrates the semantic component; it does not depict 謝 or document 謝’s earliest form.

limitations.text: No verified reusable glyph image of 謝 itself was established. The selected image is a documented modern vector rendering of its 言 semantic component, not an ancient artifact image.
